1 — VISUALS / THEME / ENGINE

Engine: Godot 4. 2D gameplay logic with 3D rendering for 2.5D. Use Node3D scene root + CharacterBody3D players locked to X/Y plane (Z fixed), orthographic or narrow-FOV Camera3D side view. UI in CanvasLayer.

ART DIRECTION

  • High-contrast B&W: unshaded + rim light, heavy fog, venetian-blind shadows.
  • Only color allowed: blood red #E10600 + muzzle flash white.
  • Suits: black vs white to read instantly at distance.
  • Rain particles, wet reflective floor (Reflector or SSR-lite shader), film grain overlay.

2.5D CONSTRAINT

  • Lock position.z = 0, lock rotation, move only on X (walk) + Y (jump).
  • 3D hitboxes: Area3D with thin box shapes, but compare only X distance.

2 — CORE LOOP: TWO CHANCES

LETHAL PHASE (TENSION)

Each round starts with has_bullet=true, has_knife=true. Gunshot or knife lunge = instant kill → cinematic execution ends round.

BRAWL PHASE (CLASSIC)

Miss / blocked / dodged = resource lost. When both lethal chances are gone → fists, kicks, blocks, grabs + classic health bar to KO.

RULES

  • Bullet: hitscan ray, can be dodged (i-frames) or blocked only by perfect parry.
  • Knife lunge: short dash + stab, whiffs if out of range or sidestepped.
  • Penalty: empty gun + lost knife force unarmed BRAWL_STATE.
  • Asymmetric tension: if P1 misses but P2 still has bullet, P1 must bait.

3 — GODOT NODE ARCHITECTURE

MAIN COMBAT SCENE

Main (Node3D) — CombatRoot.gd ├── WorldEnvironment (B/W sky, fog, grain) ├── DirectionalLight3D (key) + rim lights ├── Camera3D (side, orthographic size 6) ├── Floor (StaticBody3D + reflective plane) ├── Walls (2× StaticBody3D — arena bounds) ├── Player1 (instance: Assassin.tscn, facing right) ├── Player2 (instance: Assassin.tscn, facing left) ├── BulletTracer (pooled MeshInstance3D + particles) ├── HitStop + CameraShake (Camera logic) └── UI (CanvasLayer) ├── LethalPips (bullet/knife icons ×2 players) ├── HealthBars (hidden until Brawl) ├── RoundTimer + AnnouncementLabel └── GrainOverlay (TextureRect, film grain)

PLAYER (ASSASSIN.TSCN)

Assassin (CharacterBody3D) — player_controller.gd ├── Model (Node3D — Godot 3D suit model) │ ├── Armature (Skeleton3D + AnimationPlayer) │ └── SuitMeshes (MeshInstance3D…) ├── GunMuzzle (Marker3D) ├── KnifeTip (Marker3D) ├── LethalHitbox (Area3D — instant kill) │ └── CollisionShape3D (thin box, disabled by default) ├── BrawlHitbox (Area3D — fists/feet) ├── Hurtbox (Area3D — receives hits) ├── DodgeGhost (particles for i-frames) └── StateMachine (Node — state_machine.gd)

Why this split: LethalHitbox vs BrawlHitbox separates instant-kill collision from chip damage. Only one is armed at a time.

4 — STATE MACHINE (GDSCRIPT)

Top-level phases: LETHAL → BRAWL is one-way per round. Sub-states handle movement + attacks.

# player_controller.gd — Godot 4, CharacterBody3D
extends CharacterBody3D
enum Phase { LETHAL, BRAWL }
enum State { IDLE, WALK, JUMP, DODGE, GUNSHOT,
  KNIFE_LUNGE, PUNCH, KICK, BLOCK, GRAB, HIT, DEAD }

var phase: Phase = Phase.LETHAL
var state: State = State.IDLE
var has_bullet := true
var has_knife := true
var health := 100
var facing := 1.0
@onready var lethal_box: Area3D = $LethalHitbox
@onready var brawl_box: Area3D = $BrawlHitbox

func try_gunshot() -> void:
  if phase != Phase.LETHAL or not has_bullet: return
  has_bullet = false; _enter(State.GUNSHOT)
  $AnimationPlayer.play("gunshot")
  await get_tree().create_timer(0.12).timeout
  _fire_hitscan()  # whiff -> bullet gone
  _check_phase_shift()

func try_knife() -> void:
  if phase != Phase.LETHAL or not has_knife: return
  has_knife = false; _enter(State.KNIFE_LUNGE)
  velocity.x = facing * 14.0  # committed lunge
  lethal_box.monitoring = true
  await get_tree().create_timer(0.28).timeout
  lethal_box.monitoring = false
  _check_phase_shift()

func _check_phase_shift() -> void:
  if not has_bullet and not has_knife \
  and phase == Phase.LETHAL:
    phase = Phase.BRAWL
    UI.show_health_bars()  # tension breaks

func _on_lethal_hit(victim) -> void:
  Game.execute_cinematic(self, victim)  # round over
  victim.die_cinematic()

5 — HITBOX / HURTBOX LOGIC

INSTANT-KILL VS CHIP DAMAGE

AttackBoxStartup / Active / RecoverResult
GunshotRayCast3D 14m12f / 1f / 30fDeath. Dodge i-frames or cover avoid.
Knife lungeLethalHitbox10f / 8f / 22fDeath. Whiff = punishable.
Jab / CrossBrawlHitbox6f / 3f / 12f6 dmg
Heavy kickBrawlHitbox14f / 4f / 24f12 dmg
GrabBrawlHitbox9f / 2f / 26f15 dmg, beats block
# lethal wins over brawl; layer discipline matters
collision_layer = 2  # this player body
LethalHitbox:  monitorable=false, mask=4 (foe hurt)
BrawlHitbox:   mask=4, armed only in BRAWL phase
Hurtbox(Area3D): layer=4 — func _on_area_entered(area):
  if area.is_in_group("lethal") and not is_dodging(): die_cinematic()
  elif area.is_in_group("brawl"): take_damage(area.damage)

6 — BALANCE & FEEL

MAKE LETHAL FAIR BUT TENSE

  • Movement: walk 4.2 m/s, dash 9 m/s (16f, 8f i-frames), jump 0.55s air. Slightly slow walk = every step feels committed.
  • Dodge is the core: 200ms sidestep flicker (B&W ghost), 8f invuln, 24f recovery. Beats gun + knife if timed, loses to grab/baits.
  • Gun: 12f draw sound cue + white glint before fire. 30f holster whiff punish. Range full screen but 1px-wide ray — crouch-dodge works.
  • Knife: audible shing 10f startup, lunge locked direction. Whiff slides past opponent → back-throw punish.
  • Mind games: empty gun can still be aimed (fake) once — keeps bluff alive after miss.
  • Juice: hitstop 120ms on lethal connect, zoom punch + time-freeze 0.3s, then ink-splash execution. Whiff: loud echo + long silence.
  • Brawl transition: heartbeat stops, jazz kicks in, health bars slam on screen. 100 HP, 3-round sets keep brawls snappy (~40s).

FRAME-DATA STARTER

60fps baseline. Dodge 8/8/24 (startup/active/recover). Jab 6/3/12 (+2 on block). Block holds, chip 0 except heavy 1. Grab 9f beats block, loses to jump. Tune so dodge > lethal > block > grab > dodge.
